conclusion: The Python preflight uses plain bind while the pinned native server configures SO_REUSEADDR. The authored fixture reproduces EADDRINUSE after an owned active-close/TIME_WAIT and succeeds with SO_REUSEADDR while still rejecting a live listener. This supports a narrow consistency repair; it does not prove that the actual v19 OSError was EADDRINUSE.
